name: public-mysql-expert-base
summary: MySQL/InnoDB 知识基座：schema 设计、索引策略、查询调优、事务与锁、运维操作。供 devlab-middleware-expert 技能通过 extends 继承。借鉴自 planetscale/database-skills，去除 PlanetScale 特有内容。
runtime_requirements: This is a knowledge base skill, designed to be extended by other skills via the extends mechanism.
Prefer measured evidence (EXPLAIN, metrics) over blanket rules of thumb.
Note MySQL-version-specific behavior when giving advice.
Ask for explicit human approval before destructive data operations (drops/deletes/truncates).
post_install_hints: This skill is typically hidden from IDE listings and merged into extending skills.
If used directly, load the reference files as needed for each topic area.
